title: Emergency Conservation Program Improvement Act of 2025

claims.claim: The program helps farmers hit by natural disasters recover repair/rehabilitation money.
claims.sourceSpan: control wind erosion on farmlands or to rehabilitate farmlands damaged by wind erosion, floods, hurricanes, wildfires, or other natural disasters

claims.claim: Producers may collect up to 75% of the payment up front before rebuilding fences or rehabilitating farmland.
claims.sourceSpan: not more than 75 percent of the payment for such replacement or rehabilitation

claims.claim: The advance option was previously 25% and fencing only.
claims.sourceSpan: for the repair or replacement of fencing, the Secretary shall give the agricultural producer the option of receiving not more than 25 percent of the payment

claims.claim: Extends the same advance option to private forest owners restoring disaster-damaged woodland.
claims.sourceSpan: The Secretary shall give an owner of nonindustrial private forest land the option of receiving, before the owner carries out emergency measures under this section, not more than 75 percent of the cost of the emergency measures
claims.note: Substantively a NEW option (2206 had no advance); 'same' is a summary-level gloss, differences flagged in underreported.

claims.claim: Damage from wildfires the government caused now qualifies, when the fire spread naturally.
claims.sourceSpan: A wildfire that causes damage with respect to which a payment may be made under subsection (a) includes any wildfire that is not caused naturally, including a wildfire that is caused by the Federal Government, if the damage is caused by the spread of the fire due to natural causes

claims.claim: The program pays agricultural producers who rehabilitate farmland damaged by floods, hurricanes, wildfires, wind erosion, or other natural disasters.

claims.sourceSpan: A wildfire that causes damage with respect to which a payment may be made under subsection (a) includes any wildfire that is not caused naturally, including a wildfire that is caused by the Federal Government, if the damage is caused by the spread of the fire due to natural causes

claims.claim: The wildfire rule covers fires not caused naturally, but the bill does not say how causation is determined or documented.
claims.sourceSpan: A wildfire that causes damage with respect to which a payment may be made under subsection (a) includes any wildfire that is not caused naturally, including a wildfire that is caused by the Federal Government, if the damage is caused by the spread of the fire due to natural causes
